notes.note: #0.60-74 leader block (TextIdOffset+59+k); second Pt_Chara_Check chain in 0631.bla gives k order: Wing Zero, God, 00, Zeta, Nu, Zero, Mebius, OOO, W, Taro, Den-O Sword (Momotaros), Seven, Ultraman, Rider 1, RX. So #0.70 = Momotaros (wording fits), #0.71 Seven, #0.72 Ultraman, #0.73 Rider 1, #0.74 RX. Same order fits #0.43-57 (desu-ne = Mebius/OOO, da-ne = W).
#0.75-76 and #0.78-79 = Seravee (CHARA_NAME 73, boku = Tieria); #0.77 = Ankh (CHARA_NAME 36). 'Gundam Team' = the Sandrock/Deathscythe/Heavyarms/Birth group Seravee named in #0.40.
Ankh at the split point: read as 'past here is the Gundam Team's assignment' (their area), the Hero Team going to Area 3.

0635 chain (no God Gundam; God has his own path): Nu, Zeta, 00, Wing Zero, Ultraman, Seven, Taro, Mebius, Zero, Rider 1, RX, Den-O Sword, W, OOO. Applies to #0.3-16, #0.19-32, #0.43-56, #0.61-74; wording confirms (#0.54 Imagin = Momotaros, #0.55 Dopant = W, #0.56 Yummy = OOO, #0.30/#0.72 rough = Momotaros).

Script branches: God Gundam in party -> God explains (#0.2, #0.17-18, #0.33), leader reacts; no God -> Ankh explains (#0.57-59). #0.1 and #0.42 silent '...' = the Death Army (??? / no label). 'Death Army' not pluralised (G Gundam usage).
'kochira kara shikakeyou' -> 'we'll make the first move'; 'Death Army!!' read as Domon calling out the enemy.
Script gives #0.59 to Ankh too (CharaNameIn 36 for #0.57-59), though the 'I see!' realisation reads like another speaker; kept as Ankh.
Mebius (#0.50) and Zero (#0.51) differ only by final particle (na vs ga); kaijuu -> 'kaiju' as in earlier slices. 'nanimono da' to a machine -> 'What are you'.

report: 80/80 rows. Leader blocks mapped via each script's second Pt_Chara_Check chain (0631 and 0635 orders differ). Uncertain: #0632 0.1 'Gundam Team's job' (area vs task); #0635 0.59 assigned to Ankh by script though it reads like a separate realisation. Not in glossary: Gundam Team, Area 3, Veda (used before), mobile weapon.
